text:
Leah (partnerships): Heads up — partner Acme reported missing hourly credits in EU region between 03:00–04:00 UTC. Metrics show webhook deliveries delayed by ~7m.
MarketplaceBot: alert: webhook_delivery_latency: partner=acme region=eu avg_latency=420s failures=2
Rob (eng-partnerships): looking. Can you paste the example payload and event id from the partner? @Priya
Priya (customer-success): Sent the sample to #secure-files, event id 0f3a2b, payload attached. They saw 0 credits for those hours.
Sam (infra): Quick hypothesis: our ACK window is 5m for marketplace webhooks; if partner retries >5m we drop hour buckets. We should consider bumping to 15m and adding a latency probe.
Leah (partnerships): Agreed. Proposal: (1) add a lightweight latency probe that pings partner endpoint every 2m and records response_time, (2) increase ack_timeout to 15m for marketplace webhooks for partners with >1m monthly usage, (3) run backfill replay for affected hours.
Rob (eng-partnerships): I can ship the ack_timeout change behind a feature flag. Sam — can you sketch the probe? It should be non-auth, low-QPS.
Sam (infra): Probe sketch:
```
# probe config
partner_id: acme
interval: 120s
endpoint: https://acme.example.com/marketplace/webhook/health
timeout: 5s
record: response_ms, status_code, tls_rtt
```
Logs go to metrics.marketplace.partner_latency.
Priya (customer-success): Acme is okay with low-QPS probes. They asked we don't change payloads. They want the backfill ID shared when done.
Leah (partnerships): Backfill command (run from backfill service):
```
backfill_replay --partner-id=acme --start=2026-03-19T03:00:00Z --end=2026-03-19T04:00:00Z --granularity=hourly
```
Rob (eng-partnerships): I'll open a PR to gate ack_timeout behind flag `marketplace_ack_15m` and add rollout plan. Will also add a short-lived toggle per partner.
Sam (infra): I'll implement probe + alert rule: if p50 > 3s or failures > 1 in 10m, create P1 incident in eng-oncall and auto-scale webhook ingestion workers.
Priya (customer-success): For compliance: record consent in partner contract addendum. I'll draft and send to Acme. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Leah (partnerships): Owners + ETA:
- Rob: PR to add feature flag + rollout (ETA: today EOD)
- Sam: Probe + alert (ETA: tomorrow AM)
- Priya: contract addendum + partner ok (ETA: tomorrow EOD)
- Leah: coordinate backfill and share backfill ID to the partner once done
Rob (eng-partnerships): Assigned. I'll also add a short test harness to replay webhooks to staging:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/backfill/replay \\n  -d '{"partner":"acme","events":["0f3a2b"]}'
```
Leah (partnerships): One more: add telemetry label `ingest_path=marketplace` to backfilled events so billing can distinguish replays.
Sam (infra): noted.
Priya (customer-success): Thanks — I'll keep Acme updated. :thumbsup:
Leah (partnerships): Great. If nobody objects I'll proceed with the plan in the next 30m.
Rob (eng-partnerships): No objections. :+1:
MarketplaceBot: deploy: feature-flag marketplace_ack_15m created by rob at 2621007805
Leah (partnerships): moving to action. I'll post the backfill ID here when it's queued.
